About the Event

Join us for Swap & Savor – Fall Edition, a festive gathering to celebrate homemade, handcrafted, and homegrown foods! Bring your favorite creations — whether baked, preserved, pickled, or harvested — and swap them with fellow food enthusiasts.

It's a unique chance to share what you love, discover new flavors, and connect with others who enjoy making and sharing food. Come ready to celebrate the season, trade delicious creations, and make new friends!

What is a Food Swap?

A Food Swap is where homemade and homegrown foods become your trading currency — no money involved! It's part silent auction, part marketplace, part open house. Bring your homemade or freshly harvested specialties to exchange for other handcrafted or homegrown delights.

We'll provide swap cards, name tags, and event organization. You'll have the chance to propose trades in a silent auction-style format and choose the offers you wish to accept. Feel free to bring as much or as little as you like — there's no minimum or maximum.

Who is it for?

Residents of Mountain View and nearby communities. Whether you're a seasoned swapper or new to the concept, all are welcome. The Food Swap is all about sharing, learning, and celebrating homemade and homegrown goods.

On the Day

Please bring your handcrafted goods and arrive promptly at the start time. The first half-hour is dedicated to swapper sign-in, set-up, and samples — we'll only begin swapping once everyone's settled in. Feel free to bring samples for others to try during the open browsing portion.

Upon arrival, you'll receive swap cards to list your items and note any special ingredients, dietary information, or details about how your items were made or grown. During the swap, you can browse others' items and place silent bids, expressing interest in exchanging your items for theirs.

Tips for Swapping Success

🎁 Presentation Counts

Packaging your items neatly — think mason jars, small baskets, or pretty labels — can add a special touch and attract more interest.

🥄 Bring Sample Sizes

A few samples for people to taste can help your items stand out during the open browsing portion.

🌿 Be Open to Variety

Try to be open to the unexpected! Swaps are a great way to try new foods and get inspired by others' creativity.

🏷️ Label Everything

A simple tag with the name, key ingredients, and any allergens makes it easier for everyone to enjoy your creations.

Frequently Asked Questions

What can I bring?
Anything homemade or homegrown! Popular items include baked goods, jams, pickles, spice blends, granola, garden veggies, sauces.
How much should I bring?
What you bring is your "currency" for swapping! There's no set rule, but most people bring 6–10 portions of their item. Bring as much or as little as you like — the more you bring, the more you can trade!
How do I package it?
Choose packaging that's easy to handle, like jars, bags, or small containers, and aim for portions that encourage an even exchange. Presentation matters, so make it appealing and swap-ready!
Do I need to label my items?
Yes, please! A simple tag with the name, key ingredients, and any allergens makes it easier for everyone to enjoy.
Do I have to trade with everyone?
Not at all! You decide who to trade with based on the offers you like.
Is this a sales event?
Nope! No money changes hands. It's just for fun and community — no selling, no pitches, just good vibes and tasty trades.

Ready to Swap?
